name: kms
description: Vivantel KMS (Knowledge Management System): give your AI coding agent durable, checkable knowledge — decisions, facts, and guardrails it won't forget, contradict, or re-litigate. Get started fast with quickstart, then bootstrap a project's fact/decision/guardrail system, capture each session's decisions into it, record a decision with decide, lint it for structural rot, query it with citations, and onboard a role from it — plus check a pending change conforms, attribute commits, and uninstall cleanly.
